title: tkchart
description: Python's tkinter ships with no charting widget. I built tkchart so developers can drop live-updating line charts into any tkinter app in under five lines — no plotting library, no extra dependencies.

why-i-made-this.simple: Building a network-speed monitor in Python, I hit a wall: tkinter has no live chart widget. Instead of searching forever, I built one and published it to PyPI.

title: ctkchart
description: When CustomTkinter brought modern light/dark themes to Python desktop apps, charts stayed stuck in one colour scheme. ctkchart extends tkchart to inherit your app's active theme automatically — zero configuration required.

why-i-made-this.simple: tkchart didn't respond to CustomTkinter's theme engine. Rather than patching it, I rebuilt the core with first-class theme support and shipped it as a separate PyPI package.

title: PyTube Downloader
description: Every YouTube downloader on the web is buried under ads or capped at 1080p. PyTube Downloader is a multi-threaded desktop app that downloads single videos or full playlists from 144p to 8K — with honest progress bars and no browser required.

why-i-made-this.simple: I needed to download lecture playlists offline. Every existing tool had ads, fake progress, or quality limits. Building my own took a weekend and solved it permanently.

paragraphs: Downloading a YouTube playlist offline meant juggling browser extensions with quality caps, ad-riddled websites, and tools that lied about progress. I built PyTube Downloader to replace all of them with one honest desktop app.

The key technical decisions were around concurrency and accuracy. Running simultaneous downloads with Python's threading model required careful queue management to avoid race conditions on shared progress state. I implemented per-thread progress tracking that aggregates into a single truthful progress bar — no fake percentages, no silent failures.

Quality selection from 144p to 8K meant handling adaptive streams: video and audio arrive as separate tracks at high resolutions and must be merged post-download via FFmpeg. Building that pipeline cleanly — with proper error recovery when merges fail — was the most demanding part of the architecture.
174 stars and 21 forks later, the community's response validated the gap it filled. The SourceForge Rising Star recognition came from the download volume in the first few months alone.

title: AI Verse
description: AI tools multiply faster than anyone can track. ai-verse is a curated discovery platform where engineers, designers, and product teams can search, filter, and organise the AI tools that actually matter to their workflow — cutting hours of research to minutes.

why-i-made-this.simple: I kept losing track of useful AI tools discovered in passing. Building a structured discovery platform solved my own problem — and turned out useful for others too.

title: Auto Fuel X
description: Disconnected spreadsheets and paper ledgers leave fuel stations prone to daily errors with no audit trail. auto-fuel-x is a full-stack Jakarta EE system that digitises transactions, vehicle service records, staff scheduling, and inventory into one auditable platform.

title: IP Wizard
description: Subnetting by hand during an exam is error-prone and slow, and verifying answers without internet access is even harder. ip-wizard is an offline Android calculator for subnet masks, host ranges, and broadcast addresses — results in under a second.

why-i-made-this.simple: For my A/L ICT exam in Sri Lanka, subnetting was a core topic. I built this to check my calculations offline.

title: Tutor Booking System
description: Finding a qualified tutor is still a phone-call and WhatsApp affair for most students. This full-stack platform lets students browse verified tutor profiles, check live availability, and book sessions directly — while tutors manage schedules and earnings from a dedicated dashboard.

title: Smart Water Tank System
description: Water tanks silently overflow or run dry — wasting litres or leaving families without supply for hours. This Arduino + ESP32 IoT system monitors level via ultrasonic sensors, checks water quality with a TDS sensor, and lets you control the pump remotely from a web or mobile app over Wi-Fi.

title: Auto Mate
description: A comprehensive management system built on the MERN stack to streamline vehicle service center operations, handling service bookings, inventory, and customer records.
